headlines.title: 房贷期限上限调整 国有大行火速落地
headlines.summary: 【房贷期限上限调整 国有大行火速落地】8月28日，中国人民银行、国家金融监督管理总局联合印发《关于改革完善房地产信贷管理推动加快构建房地产发展新模式的意见》，其中明确，将个人住房贷款期限由最长30年延长至最长40年，给予借贷双方更大灵活度，具体期限由购房人与商业银行协商确定。《意见》自印发之日起施行。8月31日记者咨询相关银行官方客服后获悉，目前，建设银行、邮储银行、交通银行等多家银行已明确按照最新政策办理相关业务。

headlines.title_en: Mortgage term limit adjusted; major state-owned banks move swiftly to implement
headlines.summary_en: [Mortgage term limit adjusted, major state-owned banks implement immediately] On August 28, the PBOC and NFRA jointly issued the "Opinions on Reforming and Improving Real Estate Credit Management to Accelerate the Construction of a New Real Estate Development Model," which clarifies extending the maximum term of personal housing loans from 30 years to 40 years, giving both lenders and borrowers greater flexibility, with the specific term determined by consultation between the homebuyer and commercial bank. The Opinions took effect on the date of issuance. On August 31, after consulting official customer service hotlines of relevant banks, reporters learned that multiple banks including CCB, PSBC, and BCOM have already clearly begun handling related business according to the latest policy.

headlines.title: 中信证券：物流网短期聚焦政策落地红利 多式联运与枢纽配套建设具备高确定性
headlines.summary: 中信证券研报表示，2026年8月28日，国家发改委、交通运输部出台《物流网建设实施方案》，以降本增效为首要政策目标，明确推动“十五五”时期社会物流总费用与国内生产总值（GDP）的比率降至13.1%，较“十四五”末降低0.8个百分点。“十五五”时期物流网建设进入结构性攻坚阶段，预计降本难度抬升将带动基建投入持续扩容，中信证券测算物流网累计基建投资达3.6万亿元—4.3万亿元。展望后续，短期聚焦政策落地红利，多式联运与枢纽配套建设具备高确定性；长期来看，机会不局限于传统基建的短期工程收益，而是依托网络成型后的物流运营、供应链服务、数字化配套、产业赋能等衍生价

headlines.title_en: CITIC Securities: Logistics network short-term focus on policy implementation dividends; multimodal transport and hub supporting infrastructure offer high certainty
headlines.summary_en: CITIC Securities research report states that on August 28, 2026, the NDRC and Ministry of Transport issued the "Logistics Network Construction Implementation Plan," with cost reduction and efficiency improvement as the primary policy goal, clearly promoting a reduction in the ratio of total social logistics costs to GDP to 13.1% during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, down 0.8 percentage points from the end of the "14th Five-Year Plan." Logistics network construction enters a structural攻坚 phase during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, with expected rising difficulty in cost reduction driving continued expansion of infrastructure investment. CITIC Securities estimates cumulative infrastructure investment in the logistics network will reach RMB 3.6-4.3 trillion. Looking ahead, short-term focus on policy implementation dividends, with multimodal transport and hub supporting infrastructure construction offering high certainty; long-term, opportunities are not limited to short-term engineering gains from traditional infrastructure, but rather derive from logistics operations, supply chain services, digital supporting facilities, and industrial empowerment value once the network takes shape.

headlines.title: 8月月末为美国回购市场的温和夏季画上句号
headlines.summary: 8月隔夜回购协议的最后一个交易日，为一段资金面保持平稳的时期画上了句号，尽管自上月起美国国债短期票据的大量供给已经开始涌入市场。富国银行策略师表示，这一趋势可能延续至9月上半月，直到纳税截止日之前。 在财政部于7月开始增加短期票据发行之前，由于供给不足、市场中大量现金流动以及交易商中介服务的可用性，融资成本一直偏低。

headlines.title_en: Late August ends mild summer for U.S. repo market
headlines.summary_en: The last trading day of August for overnight repurchase agreements drew a close to a period of stable funding conditions, despite a large influx of short-dated Treasury bills hitting the market since last month. Wells Fargo strategists said this trend could extend into the first half of September ahead of the tax deadline. Before the Treasury began increasing bill issuance in July, funding costs had been low due to insufficient supply, abundant cash flows in the market, and the availability of dealer intermediation services.

headlines.title: 牛津经济研究院警告：加拿大对特朗普关税的反击将削弱经济增长
headlines.summary: 牛津经济研究院的一项研究显示，加拿大针对美国关税计划实施的报复措施或许有助于保护部分国内制造商，但将推高成本，并使许多行业处境恶化。经济学家Tony Stillo和Michael Davenport写道：“加拿大新的报复性关税将帮助部分行业，但损害大多数行业，并通过推高生产商和消费者的成本削弱全国经济增长。”

headlines.title_en: Oxford Economics warns Canada's retaliation against Trump tariffs will weaken economic growth
headlines.summary_en: A study by Oxford Economics shows that Canada's retaliatory measures against US tariff plans may help protect some domestic manufacturers but will push up costs and worsen conditions for many industries. Economists Tony Stillo and Michael Davenport wrote: "Canada's new retaliatory tariffs will help some sectors but harm most, and weaken national economic growth by raising costs for producers and consumers."

headlines.title: 10年期美债收益率涨3.2个基点，一度创2025年1月以来新高，8月份微涨1.5个基点
headlines.summary: 周一（8月31日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期基准国债收益率涨3.20个基点，报4.75%，北京时间00:10曾达到4.76%，逼近2025年1月14日顶部4.8069%、2023年10月23日顶部5.0187%，8月份累计上涨1.53个基点，整体呈现出四波V形走势。 两年期美债收益率跌0.18个基点，报4.3415%，8月份累涨5.04个基点，整体交投于4.0957%-4.3579%区间，8月3-28日持续处于下跌状态，美联储主席沃什在杰克逊霍尔全球央行年会首秀、释放鹰派立场当天显著拉升并整体转涨。

headlines.title_en: 10-year Treasury yield rises 3.2 basis points, hitting highest since January 2025 intraday; August gains 1.5 basis points
headlines.summary_en: Monday (August 31) New York close: US 10-year benchmark Treasury yield rose 3.20 basis points to 4.75%, reaching 4.76% at 00:10 Beijing time, approaching the January 14, 2025 high of 4.8069% and the October 23, 2023 high of 5.0187%; August cumulative gain of 1.53 basis points, showing four V-shaped moves overall. Two-year Treasury yield fell 0.18 basis points to 4.3415%, August cumulative gain of 5.04 basis points, trading in a 4.0957%-4.3579% range, in continuous decline from August 3-28, with a notable surge and overall turn higher on the day Fed Chair Warsh made his debut at the Jackson Hole global central bank symposium and struck a hawkish stance.

headlines.title: China’s factory activity improves in August, but stays in contraction
headlines.summary:
China’s factory activity improved in August but remained in contraction territory for a second straight month, as a pickup in orders could not fully offset the impact of overall weak domestic demand and disruptions from extreme weather.

headlines.title_en: CITIC Securities: Logistics network cumulative infrastructure investment in 15th Five-Year Plan period totals 3.6-4.3 trillion yuan
headlines.summary_en: [CITIC Securities: Cumulative infrastructure investment in logistics network during "15th Five-Year Plan" reaches RMB 3.6-4.3 trillion] CITIC Securities research report states that on August 28, 2026, the NDRC and MOT issued the "Logistics Network Construction Implementation Plan," with cost reduction and efficiency improvement as the primary policy goal, promoting a reduction in the ratio of total social logistics costs to GDP to 13.1% during the "15th Five-Year Plan," down 0.8 percentage points from the end of the "14th Five-Year Plan." Logistics network construction enters a structural攻坚 phase during the "15th Five-Year Plan," with expected rising difficulty in cost reduction driving continued expansion of infrastructure investment. CITIC Securities estimates cumulative infrastructure investment in the logistics network will reach RMB 3.6-4.3 trillion.

headlines.title_en: China Association for Public Companies: 102 new IPOs this year, mainly in electronics and machinery equipment sectors
headlines.summary_en: On August 31, the China Association for Public Companies released the 2026 semi-annual operating performance report of listed companies in the domestic stock market. As of August 31, there were 5,558 listed companies in the market, with strategic emerging industries and high-tech manufacturing accounting for 60% combined. In 2026, 102 new IPOs were added, with ChiNext, STAR Market, and BSE accounting for 82% combined, mainly concentrated in electronics and mechanical equipment industries; 21 companies were delisted, with Shanghai and Shenzhen main boards accounting for two-thirds, of which 4 involved major violations mandating forced delisting, 13 involved financial-type delistings, and 1 was voluntary delisting. HKEX financing volume surpassed last year's full-year total, with continued expansion of quality asset supply. Since the beginning of the year, 33 new A+H companies were added, nearly 100 mainland enterprises listed in Hong Kong, and a batch of hard-tech companies represented by AI and biomedicine emerged, further consolidating Hong Kong's position as a global asset allocation hub.

headlines.summary: 梳理A股公司2026年半年报可见，一个趋势愈发清晰：技术溢价正取代规模效应，成为上市公司盈利能力的核心变量。在AI算力爆发、电网“十五五”投资预期升温、创新药出海加速的背景下，掌握关键技术、构筑专利壁垒、具备全生命周期成本优势的企业，正展现出更高的毛利率、更强的订单获取能力。上海社会科学院经济研究所副所长詹宇波在接受记者采访时表示，上述变化折射出相关行业的发展阶段和发展逻辑正在切换，将倒逼企业持续加大研发投入，推动硬科技产业向高附加值环节跃迁，夯实高端制造的长期发展根基。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: From scale effects to technology premium: shifting competitiveness anchors for listed companies
headlines.summary_en: A review of A-share companies' 2026 semi-annual reports reveals an increasingly clear trend: technology premiums are replacing scale effects as the core variable in listed companies' profitability. Against the backdrop of AI computing power explosion, rising expectations for grid "15th Five-Year Plan" investment, and accelerating innovative drug overseas expansion, companies with key technologies, patent barriers, and full life-cycle cost advantages are showing higher gross margins and stronger order acquisition capabilities. Zhan Yubo, deputy director of the Institute of Economics at the Shanghai Academy of Social Sciences, told reporters that these changes reflect a shift in the development stage and logic of related industries, which will force companies to continue increasing R&D investment, promote the hard-tech industry's climb toward high value-added segments, and consolidate the long-term development foundation of high-end manufacturing. (Shanghai Securities News)
